content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, where Stripe is unavailable, and you can't collect payment through conventional platforms. You've heard of COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stacks, but you're unsure which one to choose. In this guide, we'll walk you through deploying a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-7|Cloudflare R2]]-workers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-7|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-7|cloudflare]] Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or any other restricted payment processor.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional e-commerce platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often restrictive in certain regions. They may limit or freeze accounts due to local regulations, leaving creators without a way to accept payments. COREMERCH's sovereign stacks, on the other hand, are designed to give creators full control over their digital commerce infrastructure. By leveraging open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can build a payment-agnostic store that operates independently of any single platform.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Stack 02 — the Edge Commerce Stack — uses Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling, Supabase for order storage, Cloudflare R2 for product file delivery, and Resend for transactional email. The entire stack costs nothing per month up to significant volume thresholds — Cloudflare Workers provides 100,000 requests per day free, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage free, Cloudflare R2 provides 10GB storage and zero egress fees free, and Resend provides 3,000 emails per month free. SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are configured during COREMERCH deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your repository set up and your NOWPayments account created, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves deploying your Cloudflare Pages site, setting up a Cloudflare Workers script to handle payment processing, and integrating NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. By following our step-by-step guide, you'll be able to set up a seamless payment experience for your customers.
By choosing COREMERCH's sovereign stacks, you can build a payment-agnostic digital store that operates independently of any single platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. This involves deploying your site to Cloudflare Pages, configuring your Workers script to handle payment processing, and testing your NOWPayments integration to ensure that transactions are being processed correctly. By following our guide, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start selling your digital products.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important thing to remember when deploying your digital store is to choose the right stack for your specific needs. If you're looking for a simple, low-cost solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack may be the way to go. However, if you're looking for a more advanced solution with additional features and support, the Edge Commerce Stack may be a better fit.
With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can scale your digital store to meet the demands of growing traffic and sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more advanced solution with additional features and support, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. Additionally, be sure to check out our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on our sovereign stacks.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, follow these steps: create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your site, install the Cloudflare Pages app on your GitHub repository, create an account on NOWPayments, deploy your site to Cloudflare Pages, configure your Workers script to handle payment processing, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, optimize your Cloudflare Workers script, configure your Supabase database to handle increased traffic, set up monitoring and alerting to ensure that any issues are quickly detected and resolved.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Sovereign Starter Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack is a low-cost, entry-level solution that allows you to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free. It includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, making it an ideal solution for creators who are just starting out.
What is the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Edge Commerce Stack is a more advanced solution that offers additional features and support, including 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. It's an ideal solution for creators who need a more robust and scalable digital store.
How long does it take to deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack?
The Sovereign Starter Stack can be deployed in as little as 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint.
How long does it take to deploy the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
What payment processors do you support?
We support a range of payment processors, including NOWPayments, which handles cryptocurrency transactions seamlessly.
